# check_percolation_periodic { #mofography.compute.check_percolation_periodic }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-legacy">legacy</span> Pad-and-label percolation test; superseded by axis-wise and winding solvers. Use `check_percolation_periodic2` instead.

```python
compute.check_percolation_periodic(distance_grid, threshold)
```

Return True if void voxels above threshold percolate through padded periodic faces.
